checks.name: profile-round-trip
checks.evidence: HTTP PUT /api/pandi/profile/{id} returned 200 with created fixture; GET returned the same name; missing profile returned 404.

checks.name: today-date-chat
checks.evidence: HTTP GET /api/pandi/today returned 200 with UTC date; POST /api/pandi/chat/stream returned SSE done content anchored to that date.

checks.name: files-and-history
checks.evidence: HTTP POST /api/pandi/files returned 200 for text fixture; empty returned 400 and unsupported MIME returned 415; chat history GET returned created user and assistant rows.
